description: See fashion you want in a photo, screenshot, or social or product link? Remode finds where to buy it across current retailer and resale listings. You can also describe a specific garment, shoe, bag, jewelry, watch, or wearable accessory and narrow by brand, budget, colour, size, or condition. For a retailer product page, Remode compares verified exact matches separately from similar alternatives and looks for cheaper or second-hand options. Search is account-free. With an optional linked Remode account, ChatGPT can also start, check, change, and stop the lower-price or second-hand watches you explicitly request. Remode never checks out or purchases for you.

defaultPrompt: Where can I buy this outfit?
